# Camp Buff Item: Summoning Circle

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 11, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9cca7f826bae42569aed9b5ebbea4809~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack with buffs from food, chems, drinks, armor, and other sources.

However, you cannot stack multiple camp items that provide the same buff—for example, two items that both grant Luck or Intelligence will not stack. Additionally, camp item buffs do not stack with themselves.

Summon some inspiration and connect with a smarter power!

- Using the Summoning Circle will grant an Intelligence Boost -

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Summoning Circle__

Image Credit: Nerevar

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_685d1430e895429dbc667b85d7bf44af~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

+2 Intelligence

Does not stack with other Intelligence Camp Buff items.

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:**

Yes

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Misc Structures

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Wool

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Summoning Circle - 700 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
